failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Benchmark semantic-contrast preflight rate is not exactly 1.0 or any negative fixture is semantically indistinguishable from an accepted control.
Development or held-out accepted-envelope exact-match rate is below 0.95, negative classification is not 1.0, or corrective-prompt proxy reduction is below 0.50.
Any scope expansion, missing critical constraint, prerequisite escape, owner-decision escape, verifier self-certification escape, or invalid-input escape occurs.
Obligation retention, continuation-state exactness, deterministic repeat, parent preflight, spec quality, frozen hash integrity, or inherited regression pass rate is below 1.0.
Context over-inclusion exceeds 0.05, critical gate bypass count is nonzero, or missing data is treated as zero/pass.
Any applicable regression fails or disappears without governed retirement.
The independent evaluator actor equals the implementation actor.
Required self-dogfood, historical shadow evidence, rollback, retrospective, immutable snapshots, manifest-last seal, or fresh extracted-package verification is missing.

goals.acceptance: Development and held-out exact accepted-envelope rates are each >= 0.95.
goals.description: Compile exact deterministic bounded prompt envelopes across all five prompt kinds.

goals.acceptance: Corrective-prompt proxy reduction rate >= 0.50 with complete denominator reconciliation.
goals.description: Reduce task-context corrective prompting versus the frozen generic baseline.

goals.acceptance: Negative classification accuracy = 1.0 with zero scope/prerequisite/owner/self-certification escapes.
goals.description: Fail closed on scope, prerequisite, owner-decision, verifier-role, and context-closure violations.

goals.acceptance: Continuation-state exactness, obligation retention, and deterministic repeat = 1.0; context over-inclusion <= 0.05.
goals.description: Preserve exact continuation state, critical obligations, and deterministic explainable context closure.

goals.acceptance: Exact v0.08 parent suite, all active regressions, independent verification, reconciliation, rollback, and extracted-package integrity pass.
goals.description: Preserve promoted-parent integrity and produce reproducible release evidence.

hash_scope: Canonical JSON excluding contract_hash. Frozen criteria additionally bind exact bytes of the approved spec, two prompt schemas, generic baseline, development/held-out/combined corpora, evaluation plan, and both preregistration preflights by explicit failure-condition hashes.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and every frozen primary/guardrail metric meets target.
All metrics reconcile to raw frozen corpus results and denominator snapshots; missing data is not zero.
All active regressions PASS and meaningful defects are considered for permanent regression memory.
Approved spec, prompt schemas, baseline, development/held-out corpora, evaluation plan, parent/schema preflights, and contract hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
Required self-dogfood and historical v0.08 shadow evidence are recorded; shadow data is non-promotional.
No critical open defect remains; rollback, retrospective, continuation state, version-local snapshots, manifest-last seal, and extracted-package verification are complete.
Because same-cycle synthetic evidence is not organizationally independent, maximum classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Bind every compiled prompt to candidate version, graph hash, task ID, prompt kind, and governed evidence identifiers.
Restrict implementation/debug writes to compiled task scope while preserving prerequisites, acceptance criteria, tests, and gates.
Refuse implementation/debug prompts when prerequisites or owner decisions block work.
Require role-separated verification prompts with frozen checks and no candidate self-certification.
Compile continuation prompts from replayed immutable execution evidence without rewriting task history.
Use deterministic provable context closure and fail closed when safe minimization cannot be proven.
Preserve completion-evidence and non-weakening constraints in executable/verification prompts.
Expose deterministic Python API and CLI with versioned prompt envelopes and structured failures.
Preserve exact sealed v0.08 parent behavior and every active regression.
Evaluate on frozen development/held-out fixtures across all prompt kinds, blockers, attacks, and handoffs.
Hash-lock baseline, corpora, schemas, plan, and parent-preflight evidence before implementation.
Dogfood v0.09.1.1 prompts and run non-promotional shadow checks on historical v0.08 task/execution shapes.
Require reconciled metrics/gates, independent verification, rollback/retrospective/continuation, and manifest-last extracted-package integrity.

requirements.text: Every negative benchmark fixture has a mechanically observable semantic mutation consistent with its expected diagnostic; semantic-contrast preflight passes before freeze.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.09.1.1 fails, preserve all frozen/failed v0.09.1.1 evidence and continue using sealed v0.08 executable behavior; do not rewrite parent ledgers, snapshots, contracts, or regressions.
